sources.entry: 24. Generrated - A platform for exploring and creating AI-generated art.

summary.name: Generrated
summary.one_liner: A reference and inspiration site showing 9,300 images generated from DALL·E 2 and DALL·E 3 text prompts, with the prompt used for each image.
use_cases: Comparing DALL·E 2 and DALL·E 3 outputs for the same prompt
Finding inspiration for AI image prompts
Studying style and bias in AI-generated images
summary.what_it_does: The site collects around 9,300 images generated with DALL·E 2 and DALL·E 3 from text prompts. Clicking an image shows its prompt and the three other images generated alongside it. Each prompt also has a page with all 20 images (40 if DALL·E 3 versions exist). The author plans to add more DALL·E 3 images to allow side-by-side comparison with DALL·E 2 versions. The page also includes a grid comparing prompts by artist, style, method and century, though those cells are empty in the captured text.
notable: Around 9,300 DALL·E 2 and DALL·E 3 images organized by prompt
Each prompt page shows 20 images (40 where DALL·E 3 exists) to see shared style
Built as a reference for learning prompt design and AI bias
caveats: Plans to add more DALL·E 3 images are still in progress, so DALL·E 3 coverage is incomplete
The author notes image generation was expensive
